criteria.justification: The response explicitly says the research supports “a unified view and no duplicate alerts” but “doesn’t show that overwriting is the right way,” clearly separating the customer goal from the proposed mechanism.
It recommends keeping “the existing field’s meaning unchanged so current integrations continue to work” and rejects silently changing its semantics, directly addressing compatibility risk.
The response proposes a stable event identity so the later result updates the same event “rather than creating a second alert,” and notes that option 3 avoids duplicate records for one incident.

It commits to one event with one lifecycle, the unchanged existing estimate field, and a separate field populated by the later precise pipeline; it also suggests a separately named, documented “best available” field if needed.
It accepts the reviewer’s customer-simplicity objective by preserving one unified event and explains why option 3 achieves that goal without the integration-breaking semantics of overwriting.
